Privacy Policy

Last updated: 9 September 2026

This policy explains how inaivu IT collects and uses information submitted through this website.

Information we collect

When you send an enquiry, we may receive your name, email address, phone number and the message you provide. Basic technical information may also be processed by our hosting and security providers.

How we use it

  • To respond to enquiries and provide requested services.
  • To maintain the security and reliability of this website.
  • To meet applicable legal and regulatory obligations.

Sharing and retention

We do not sell personal information. Information may be processed by service providers used to operate the website and enquiry form. We retain it only as long as reasonably necessary for the purpose collected or as required by law.

Your choices

You may ask us to access, correct or delete information you have submitted, subject to applicable legal requirements.

Contact

For privacy questions, email pr@inaivuit.com.
